# GENERATED by tools/gen_queue.py. Do not edit by hand.

# Copies slot $FROM$ over slot $TO$ (an empty slot empties $TO$).
dsm_slot_copy = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = dsm_s$FROM$_target }
		set_variable = { name = dsm_s$TO$_target value = var:dsm_s$FROM$_target }
		set_variable = { name = dsm_s$TO$_year value = var:dsm_s$FROM$_year }
		set_variable = { name = dsm_s$TO$_month value = var:dsm_s$FROM$_month }
		set_variable = { name = dsm_s$TO$_day value = var:dsm_s$FROM$_day }
		set_variable = { name = dsm_s$TO$_anchor value = var:dsm_s$FROM$_anchor }
		set_variable = { name = dsm_s$TO$_reason value = var:dsm_s$FROM$_reason }
		set_variable = { name = dsm_s$TO$_repeat value = var:dsm_s$FROM$_repeat }
		set_variable = { name = dsm_s$TO$_num value = var:dsm_s$FROM$_num }
		set_variable = { name = dsm_s$TO$_dup value = var:dsm_s$FROM$_dup }
	}
	else = { dsm_slot_remove = { N = $TO$ } }
}

dsm_slot_remove = {
	remove_variable = dsm_s$N$_target
	remove_variable = dsm_s$N$_year
	remove_variable = dsm_s$N$_month
	remove_variable = dsm_s$N$_day
	remove_variable = dsm_s$N$_anchor
	remove_variable = dsm_s$N$_reason
	remove_variable = dsm_s$N$_repeat
	remove_variable = dsm_s$N$_num
	remove_variable = dsm_s$N$_dup
}

dsm_slot_swap = {
	dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = $A$ TO = tmp }
	dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = $B$ TO = $A$ }
	dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = tmp TO = $B$ }
	dsm_slot_remove = { N = tmp }
}

# Sorts the used slots by date, soonest first.

# Puts the staged alarm (dsm_snew_*) in the first free slot, then re-sorts. No-op if full.
dsm_queue_insert_new = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target } } dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = new TO = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target } } dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = new TO = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target } } dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = new TO = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target } } dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = new TO = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target } } dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = new TO = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target } } dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = new TO = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target } } dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = new TO = 7 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target } } dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = new TO = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target } } dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = new TO = 9 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target } } dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = new TO = 10 } }
	dsm_queue_sort = yes
}

# Deletes slot 1 and moves the later ones up.
dsm_queue_delete_1 = {
	dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = 2 TO = 1 }
	dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = 3 TO = 2 }
	dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = 4 TO = 3 }
	dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = 5 TO = 4 }
	dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = 6 TO = 5 }
	dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = 7 TO = 6 }
	dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = 8 TO = 7 }
	dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = 9 TO = 8 }
	dsm_slot_copy = { FROM = 10 TO = 9 }
	dsm_slot_remove = { N = 10 }
}

	dsm_slot_remove = { N = 1 }
	dsm_slot_remove = { N = 2 }
	dsm_slot_remove = { N = 3 }
	dsm_slot_remove = { N = 4 }
	dsm_slot_remove = { N = 5 }
	dsm_slot_remove = { N = 6 }
	dsm_slot_remove = { N = 7 }
	dsm_slot_remove = { N = 8 }
	dsm_slot_remove = { N = 9 }
	dsm_slot_remove = { N = 10 }
}

# Recounts the queue and marks reasons used by more than one alarm.
dsm_queue_refresh = {
	set_variable = { name = dsm_queue_count value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target } change_variable = { name = dsm_queue_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target } change_variable = { name = dsm_queue_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target } change_variable = { name = dsm_queue_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target } change_variable = { name = dsm_queue_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target } change_variable = { name = dsm_queue_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target } change_variable = { name = dsm_queue_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target } change_variable = { name = dsm_queue_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target } change_variable = { name = dsm_queue_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target } change_variable = { name = dsm_queue_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target } change_variable = { name = dsm_queue_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target } set_variable = { name = dsm_s1_dup value = 0 } if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target var:dsm_s2_reason = var:dsm_s1_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target var:dsm_s3_reason = var:dsm_s1_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target var:dsm_s4_reason = var:dsm_s1_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target var:dsm_s5_reason = var:dsm_s1_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target var:dsm_s6_reason = var:dsm_s1_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target var:dsm_s7_reason = var:dsm_s1_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target var:dsm_s8_reason = var:dsm_s1_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target var:dsm_s9_reason = var:dsm_s1_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target var:dsm_s10_reason = var:dsm_s1_reason } } } set_variable = { name = dsm_s1_dup value = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target } set_variable = { name = dsm_s2_dup value = 0 } if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target var:dsm_s1_reason = var:dsm_s2_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target var:dsm_s3_reason = var:dsm_s2_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target var:dsm_s4_reason = var:dsm_s2_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target var:dsm_s5_reason = var:dsm_s2_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target var:dsm_s6_reason = var:dsm_s2_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target var:dsm_s7_reason = var:dsm_s2_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target var:dsm_s8_reason = var:dsm_s2_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target var:dsm_s9_reason = var:dsm_s2_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target var:dsm_s10_reason = var:dsm_s2_reason } } } set_variable = { name = dsm_s2_dup value = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target } set_variable = { name = dsm_s3_dup value = 0 } if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target var:dsm_s1_reason = var:dsm_s3_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target var:dsm_s2_reason = var:dsm_s3_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target var:dsm_s4_reason = var:dsm_s3_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target var:dsm_s5_reason = var:dsm_s3_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target var:dsm_s6_reason = var:dsm_s3_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target var:dsm_s7_reason = var:dsm_s3_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target var:dsm_s8_reason = var:dsm_s3_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target var:dsm_s9_reason = var:dsm_s3_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target var:dsm_s10_reason = var:dsm_s3_reason } } } set_variable = { name = dsm_s3_dup value = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target } set_variable = { name = dsm_s4_dup value = 0 } if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target var:dsm_s1_reason = var:dsm_s4_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target var:dsm_s2_reason = var:dsm_s4_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target var:dsm_s3_reason = var:dsm_s4_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target var:dsm_s5_reason = var:dsm_s4_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target var:dsm_s6_reason = var:dsm_s4_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target var:dsm_s7_reason = var:dsm_s4_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target var:dsm_s8_reason = var:dsm_s4_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target var:dsm_s9_reason = var:dsm_s4_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target var:dsm_s10_reason = var:dsm_s4_reason } } } set_variable = { name = dsm_s4_dup value = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target } set_variable = { name = dsm_s5_dup value = 0 } if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target var:dsm_s1_reason = var:dsm_s5_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target var:dsm_s2_reason = var:dsm_s5_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target var:dsm_s3_reason = var:dsm_s5_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target var:dsm_s4_reason = var:dsm_s5_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target var:dsm_s6_reason = var:dsm_s5_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target var:dsm_s7_reason = var:dsm_s5_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target var:dsm_s8_reason = var:dsm_s5_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target var:dsm_s9_reason = var:dsm_s5_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target var:dsm_s10_reason = var:dsm_s5_reason } } } set_variable = { name = dsm_s5_dup value = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target } set_variable = { name = dsm_s6_dup value = 0 } if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target var:dsm_s1_reason = var:dsm_s6_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target var:dsm_s2_reason = var:dsm_s6_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target var:dsm_s3_reason = var:dsm_s6_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target var:dsm_s4_reason = var:dsm_s6_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target var:dsm_s5_reason = var:dsm_s6_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target var:dsm_s7_reason = var:dsm_s6_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target var:dsm_s8_reason = var:dsm_s6_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target var:dsm_s9_reason = var:dsm_s6_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target var:dsm_s10_reason = var:dsm_s6_reason } } } set_variable = { name = dsm_s6_dup value = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target } set_variable = { name = dsm_s7_dup value = 0 } if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target var:dsm_s1_reason = var:dsm_s7_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target var:dsm_s2_reason = var:dsm_s7_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target var:dsm_s3_reason = var:dsm_s7_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target var:dsm_s4_reason = var:dsm_s7_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target var:dsm_s5_reason = var:dsm_s7_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target var:dsm_s6_reason = var:dsm_s7_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target var:dsm_s8_reason = var:dsm_s7_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target var:dsm_s9_reason = var:dsm_s7_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target var:dsm_s10_reason = var:dsm_s7_reason } } } set_variable = { name = dsm_s7_dup value = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target } set_variable = { name = dsm_s8_dup value = 0 } if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target var:dsm_s1_reason = var:dsm_s8_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target var:dsm_s2_reason = var:dsm_s8_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target var:dsm_s3_reason = var:dsm_s8_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target var:dsm_s4_reason = var:dsm_s8_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target var:dsm_s5_reason = var:dsm_s8_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target var:dsm_s6_reason = var:dsm_s8_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target var:dsm_s7_reason = var:dsm_s8_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target var:dsm_s9_reason = var:dsm_s8_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target var:dsm_s10_reason = var:dsm_s8_reason } } } set_variable = { name = dsm_s8_dup value = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target } set_variable = { name = dsm_s9_dup value = 0 } if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target var:dsm_s1_reason = var:dsm_s9_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target var:dsm_s2_reason = var:dsm_s9_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target var:dsm_s3_reason = var:dsm_s9_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target var:dsm_s4_reason = var:dsm_s9_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target var:dsm_s5_reason = var:dsm_s9_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target var:dsm_s6_reason = var:dsm_s9_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target var:dsm_s7_reason = var:dsm_s9_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target var:dsm_s8_reason = var:dsm_s9_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target var:dsm_s10_reason = var:dsm_s9_reason } } } set_variable = { name = dsm_s9_dup value = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target } set_variable = { name = dsm_s10_dup value = 0 } if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target var:dsm_s1_reason = var:dsm_s10_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target var:dsm_s2_reason = var:dsm_s10_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target var:dsm_s3_reason = var:dsm_s10_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target var:dsm_s4_reason = var:dsm_s10_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target var:dsm_s5_reason = var:dsm_s10_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target var:dsm_s6_reason = var:dsm_s10_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target var:dsm_s7_reason = var:dsm_s10_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target var:dsm_s8_reason = var:dsm_s10_reason } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target var:dsm_s9_reason = var:dsm_s10_reason } } } set_variable = { name = dsm_s10_dup value = 1 } } }
}

# Gives the staged alarm the lowest number not used by another alarm with the same reason.
dsm_new_assign_num = {
	set_variable = { name = dsm_snew_num value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = dsm_snew_dup value = 0 }
	while = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = dsm_s1_target var:dsm_s1_reason = var:dsm_snew_reason var:dsm_s1_num = var:dsm_snew_num } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s2_target var:dsm_s2_reason = var:dsm_snew_reason var:dsm_s2_num = var:dsm_snew_num } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s3_target var:dsm_s3_reason = var:dsm_snew_reason var:dsm_s3_num = var:dsm_snew_num } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s4_target var:dsm_s4_reason = var:dsm_snew_reason var:dsm_s4_num = var:dsm_snew_num } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s5_target var:dsm_s5_reason = var:dsm_snew_reason var:dsm_s5_num = var:dsm_snew_num } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s6_target var:dsm_s6_reason = var:dsm_snew_reason var:dsm_s6_num = var:dsm_snew_num } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s7_target var:dsm_s7_reason = var:dsm_snew_reason var:dsm_s7_num = var:dsm_snew_num } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s8_target var:dsm_s8_reason = var:dsm_snew_reason var:dsm_s8_num = var:dsm_snew_num } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s9_target var:dsm_s9_reason = var:dsm_snew_reason var:dsm_s9_num = var:dsm_snew_num } AND = { has_variable = dsm_s10_target var:dsm_s10_reason = var:dsm_snew_reason var:dsm_s10_num = var:dsm_snew_num } } } change_variable = { name = dsm_snew_num add = 1 } }
}

dsm_fired_reset = {
	remove_variable = dsm_f1_reason
	remove_variable = dsm_f1_num
	remove_variable = dsm_f1_dup
	remove_variable = dsm_f1_repeat
	remove_variable = dsm_f1_next_year
	remove_variable = dsm_f1_next_month
	remove_variable = dsm_f1_next_day
	remove_variable = dsm_f1_ended
	remove_variable = dsm_f2_reason
	remove_variable = dsm_f2_num
	remove_variable = dsm_f2_dup
	remove_variable = dsm_f2_repeat
	remove_variable = dsm_f2_next_year
	remove_variable = dsm_f2_next_month
	remove_variable = dsm_f2_next_day
	remove_variable = dsm_f2_ended
	remove_variable = dsm_f3_reason

	remove_variable = dsm_f6_ended
	remove_variable = dsm_f7_reason
	remove_variable = dsm_f7_num
	remove_variable = dsm_f7_dup
	remove_variable = dsm_f7_repeat
	remove_variable = dsm_f7_next_year
	remove_variable = dsm_f7_next_month
	remove_variable = dsm_f7_next_day
	remove_variable = dsm_f7_ended
	remove_variable = dsm_f8_reason
	remove_variable = dsm_f8_num
	remove_variable = dsm_f8_dup

	remove_variable = dsm_f10_dup

	remove_variable = dsm_f10_next_year
	remove_variable = dsm_f10_next_month
	remove_variable = dsm_f10_next_day
	remove_variable = dsm_f10_ended
	remove_variable = dsm_f_last
}

# Records the staged alarm as fired today, for the popup.
dsm_fired_push = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_f1_reason } } set_variable = { name = dsm_f1_reason value = var:dsm_snew_reason } set_variable = { name = dsm_f1_num value = var:dsm_snew_num } set_variable = { name = dsm_f1_dup value = var:dsm_snew_dup } set_variable = { name = dsm_f1_repeat value = var:dsm_snew_repeat } set_variable = { name = dsm_f_last value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_f2_reason } } set_variable = { name = dsm_f2_reason value = var:dsm_snew_reason } set_variable = { name = dsm_f2_num value = var:dsm_snew_num } set_variable = { name = dsm_f2_dup value = var:dsm_snew_dup } set_variable = { name = dsm_f2_repeat value = var:dsm_snew_repeat } set_variable = { name = dsm_f_last value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_f3_reason } } set_variable = { name = dsm_f3_reason value = var:dsm_snew_reason } set_variable = { name = dsm_f3_num value = var:dsm_snew_num } set_variable = { name = dsm_f3_dup value = var:dsm_snew_dup } set_variable = { name = dsm_f3_repeat value = var:dsm_snew_repeat } set_variable = { name = dsm_f_last value = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_f4_reason } } set_variable = { name = dsm_f4_reason value = var:dsm_snew_reason } set_variable = { name = dsm_f4_num value = var:dsm_snew_num } set_variable = { name = dsm_f4_dup value = var:dsm_snew_dup } set_variable = { name = dsm_f4_repeat value = var:dsm_snew_repeat } set_variable = { name = dsm_f_last value = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_f5_reason } } set_variable = { name = dsm_f5_reason value = var:dsm_snew_reason } set_variable = { name = dsm_f5_num value = var:dsm_snew_num } set_variable = { name = dsm_f5_dup value = var:dsm_snew_dup } set_variable = { name = dsm_f5_repeat value = var:dsm_snew_repeat } set_variable = { name = dsm_f_last value = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_f6_reason } } set_variable = { name = dsm_f6_reason value = var:dsm_snew_reason } set_variable = { name = dsm_f6_num value = var:dsm_snew_num } set_variable = { name = dsm_f6_dup value = var:dsm_snew_dup } set_variable = { name = dsm_f6_repeat value = var:dsm_snew_repeat } set_variable = { name = dsm_f_last value = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_f7_reason } } set_variable = { name = dsm_f7_reason value = var:dsm_snew_reason } set_variable = { name = dsm_f7_num value = var:dsm_snew_num } set_variable = { name = dsm_f7_dup value = var:dsm_snew_dup } set_variable = { name = dsm_f7_repeat value = var:dsm_snew_repeat } set_variable = { name = dsm_f_last value = 7 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_f8_reason } } set_variable = { name = dsm_f8_reason value = var:dsm_snew_reason } set_variable = { name = dsm_f8_num value = var:dsm_snew_num } set_variable = { name = dsm_f8_dup value = var:dsm_snew_dup } set_variable = { name = dsm_f8_repeat value = var:dsm_snew_repeat } set_variable = { name = dsm_f_last value = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_f9_reason } } set_variable = { name = dsm_f9_reason value = var:dsm_snew_reason } set_variable = { name = dsm_f9_num value = var:dsm_snew_num } set_variable = { name = dsm_f9_dup value = var:dsm_snew_dup } set_variable = { name = dsm_f9_repeat value = var:dsm_snew_repeat } set_variable = { name = dsm_f_last value = 9 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = dsm_f10_reason } } set_variable = { name = dsm_f10_reason value = var:dsm_snew_reason } set_variable = { name = dsm_f10_num value = var:dsm_snew_num } set_variable = { name = dsm_f10_dup value = var:dsm_snew_dup } set_variable = { name = dsm_f10_repeat value = var:dsm_snew_repeat } set_variable = { name = dsm_f_last value = 10 } }
}

# Records the staged alarm's next date on the last fired entry.
dsm_fired_set_next = {
	if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 1 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f1_next_year value = var:dsm_snew_year } set_variable = { name = dsm_f1_next_month value = var:dsm_snew_month } set_variable = { name = dsm_f1_next_day value = var:dsm_snew_day } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 2 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f2_next_year value = var:dsm_snew_year } set_variable = { name = dsm_f2_next_month value = var:dsm_snew_month } set_variable = { name = dsm_f2_next_day value = var:dsm_snew_day } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 3 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f3_next_year value = var:dsm_snew_year } set_variable = { name = dsm_f3_next_month value = var:dsm_snew_month } set_variable = { name = dsm_f3_next_day value = var:dsm_snew_day } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 4 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f4_next_year value = var:dsm_snew_year } set_variable = { name = dsm_f4_next_month value = var:dsm_snew_month } set_variable = { name = dsm_f4_next_day value = var:dsm_snew_day } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 5 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f5_next_year value = var:dsm_snew_year } set_variable = { name = dsm_f5_next_month value = var:dsm_snew_month } set_variable = { name = dsm_f5_next_day value = var:dsm_snew_day } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 6 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f6_next_year value = var:dsm_snew_year } set_variable = { name = dsm_f6_next_month value = var:dsm_snew_month } set_variable = { name = dsm_f6_next_day value = var:dsm_snew_day } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 7 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f7_next_year value = var:dsm_snew_year } set_variable = { name = dsm_f7_next_month value = var:dsm_snew_month } set_variable = { name = dsm_f7_next_day value = var:dsm_snew_day } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 8 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f8_next_year value = var:dsm_snew_year } set_variable = { name = dsm_f8_next_month value = var:dsm_snew_month } set_variable = { name = dsm_f8_next_day value = var:dsm_snew_day } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 9 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f9_next_year value = var:dsm_snew_year } set_variable = { name = dsm_f9_next_month value = var:dsm_snew_month } set_variable = { name = dsm_f9_next_day value = var:dsm_snew_day } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 10 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f10_next_year value = var:dsm_snew_year } set_variable = { name = dsm_f10_next_month value = var:dsm_snew_month } set_variable = { name = dsm_f10_next_day value = var:dsm_snew_day } }
}

# Marks the last fired entry as a repeat that can't continue (year cap).
dsm_fired_set_ended = {
	if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 1 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f1_ended value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 2 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f2_ended value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 3 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f3_ended value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 4 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f4_ended value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 5 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f5_ended value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 6 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f6_ended value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 7 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f7_ended value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 8 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f8_ended value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 9 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f9_ended value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_f_last = 10 } set_variable = { name = dsm_f10_ended value = 1 } }
}
